title: Shield + Totem
description: Do you know that feeling when you're setting out on an adventure but can't decide whether to equip a Totem of Undying or a Shield? This small datapack allows you to craft a Totem Component that, when combined with a Shield, creates a Shield of Undying.
body: To get the totem component put emerald block, totem of undying and silence armor trim in smithing table. Then put it back there and add netherite upgrade and shield. Shield of Undying works like normal shield but disappears ater death.
